subject.title: Bug: preflight (budget-triggered) compaction hard-capped at ~60s, ignores compaction.timeoutSeconds

question: Should #95590's filtered preflight cancellation signal be the canonical fix for #95553, with the preflight-disable config gate left as a separate product decision?
rationale: The issue can be fixed either by changing timeout/cancellation ownership or by adding a new config gate, and the config surface plus explicit cancellation behavior need maintainer intent before another automated repair is queued.

options.title: Accept #95590 as canonical
options.body: Land the filtered-signal fix after maintainer review so lifecycle timeouts no longer cap required preflight compaction while explicit cancellation still works.

options.title: Require live slow-backend proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until the reporter or maintainer provides a redacted run against the slow vLLM/Qwen setup.

options.title: Prefer a config gate instead
options.body: Treat the timeout behavior as acceptable and pursue a separate `compaction.preflight` disable knob despite the added config surface.

recommendation.title: Accept #95590 as canonical
recommendation.body: Land the filtered-signal fix after maintainer review so lifecycle timeouts no longer cap required preflight compaction while explicit cancellation still works.

likelyOwner.reason: The open choice is primarily the reply lifecycle cancellation contract introduced by PR #61267.
